text.tspan: Toda mudança começa com um frio na barriga.
E é nesse frio que nasce a coragem.
que também temos asas para alçar a liberdade.
A young Tyrannosaurus Rex, just a toddler, rendered in a charming watercolor style (aquarelle
painting method). His primary color is a sunny yellow, the kind that makes you smile. He's been
drawn with a slimmer, more elongated body than you might typically imagine for a T-Rex,
emphasizing his youthfulness. This makes him appear a little taller and less bulky, enhancing his
cute and approachable demeanor. His head is large and round with big, endearing eyes that are a
deep, captivating blue, complete with bright white highlights that make them sparkle. A gentle
smile curves his mouth, revealing tiny, harmless teeth. His small arms, characteristic of a T-Rex,
are held slightly away from his body, and his sturdy legs end in rounded, three-clawed feet. A row
of soft, rounded spikes runs down his back and along his tail, painted in slightly muted shades of
yellow and orange, adding to his gentle appearance. Present the young Tyrannosaurus Rex riding
a bike with both feet up, he is wearing a blue bike helmet and he is having fun. Picture him in a
blank white background (void). The watercolor technique gives him a soft, slightly textured look,
as if the paint has just dried on the page, perfect for a sweet illustration in a toddler's book.
